x-e-e4-01.title: Yaadannoo Haadha fi yeroo taphaa Jisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Karoora hedduu yaadannoo Haadha irra jiru yeroo hiriyyaan yaada kenne waliin wal bira qabi, iddoo wal hin simanne argi, fi Ingiliffaan lakkii jedhii yeroo adda ta'e yaada kenni.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Yaadannoo Haadhni minjaa irra dhiifte (barreeffamaan qofa, fakkii malee):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Achiis hiriyyaan ishee Jisu ergaa barreeffamaa erge. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Yeroo yaadannoo irra jiru fi daangaa yeroo yaadame tokkoon tokkoon wal bira qabi
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: 'Daangaan' yeroo fi yeroon tokko wal irra bu'a moo hin bu'in murteessuu
x-e-e4-01.prereq.0: Hiika p.m. fi yeroo dubbisuu (akka 3:30 fi 4:00)
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Jechoota salphaa akka piano class fi trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Sararoota yaadannoo yeroo yaada Jisu (4:15-5:15) waliin wal irra bu'an hundaa filadhu.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarara tokko tokkoo yeroo paarkii '4:15-5:15' bira kaa'ii, dura xumuramu moo booda jalqabu ilaali.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wantoota yeroo fudhatan, akka barnoota, yeroo xumuraman herregi.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Yeroon manatti dhufuu 4:15 dura moo booda wal bira qabi.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Barnoonni sa'aatii meeqatti akka jalqabuu fi akka xumuramu herregii yeroo paarkii bira kaa'i.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Yeroon tokko daangaa yeroo paarkii keessa kufe moo hin kufne mirkaneessuu jedhee yaadeen ture.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Yeroon nyaataa yeroo paarkii xumuramee booda moo hin taane wal bira qabi.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Barnoonni piyaanoo 4:00-4:30 dha, kanaaf 4:15-4:30 wal irra bu'a, fi trash baasuun 5:00 tti 4:15-5:15 keessa kufa. Manatti dhufuu 3:30 fi nyaata 6:30 yeroo paarkii alatti dha.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Jisu'f deebii Ingiliffaa himoota lama ykn sadi keessatti deebisi. Sababoota yaadannoo irratti maaliif deemuu hin dandeenye argi, barreessi, fi yeroo biraa hojjetu tokko yaada kenni.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dura, lakkii jedhii himni tokkoon 'Sorry, I can't ...' tiin.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Karoora wal irra bu'an lamaan yaadannoo irraa yeroo isaanii waliin barreessi, fi dhuma irratti yaada kee 'Can we play at ...?' tiin kenni.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Sababoota lamaan, piyaanoo fi trash baasuu, kennitee?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Yeroo adda ta'e yaada kennite, fi yeroon sun karoora yaadannoo waliin wal irra hin bu'u?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii gaarii yeroo akka daangaa yaada kenne.

x-e-e4-02.title: Yeroo saree fiddu fi hojii manaa murteessuu
x-e-e4-02.goal: Walitti makamaa yeroo fiddu fi yeroo hojii manaa haalota yaadannoo Abbaa irra jiran hundaa guutan adda addaa hedduu hojjedhu.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Yaadannoo Abbaan dhiise (barreeffamaan qofa, fakkii malee):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Armaan gaditti, yeroo tokko tokkoo '4:00 p.m. booda daqiiqaa meeqa' jedhii barreessi. Fakkeenyaaf, 4:30 yoo jalqabde 30 barreessi, fi 5:15 yoo jalqabde 75 barreessi.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Deebii haalota hedduu yeroo tokkotti guutu mataa kee hojjechuu
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Yeroo itti fudhatu yeroo jalqabaa irratti dabalii yeroo xumuramu mirkaneeffadhu
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Jechoota salphaa akka walk the dog fi homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Mina hojii manaa sa'aatii 5:00 tti jalqabdee fi fiddu 5:30 tti yoo jalqabde, haala yaadannoo irra jiru kam cabsiti?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yeroo itti fudhatu (daqiiqaadhaan) yeroo jalqabaa hojii tokko tokkoo irratti dabalii yeroo xumuramu argi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Daangaa yeroo hojiiwwan lamaanii sarara tokko irratti cinaa cinaa kaa'i.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Yeroon fiddu jalqabu 5:30 5:00 dura moo booda wal bira qabi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Hojii manaa 5:00-6:00 fi fiddu 5:30-6:00 sarara yeroo irratti cinaa cinaa kaa'i.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Yeroo itti fudhatu yeroo jalqabaa irratti dabaluun yeroo xumuraa hojii lamaanii argi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Kun haala hojiin hanga kam turu ilaalu dha, yeroo jalqabaa miti.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Hojii manaa 5:00-6:00 dha fi fiddu 5:30-6:00 dha, kanaaf hojiiwwan lamaan 5:30 irraa 6:00 wal irra bu'u. Fiddu 5:00 booda jalqaba fi lamaanuu 6:30 dura xumuramu, kanaaf haalonni kaan eegamu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Karoora adda addaa 3 haalota yaadannoo irra jiran hundaa eegu hojjedhu. w jalqaba fiddu fi k jalqaba hojii manaa (4:00 p.m. booda daqiiqaa meeqa).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dura daangaa w jalqaba fiddu ta'uu danda'u murteessi, achiis k jalqaba hojii manaa yeroo fiddu sana irraa fagaatu filadhu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yeroo xumuramu jalqaba hojii tokko tokkoo fi yeroo itti fudhatu irraa argi, fi hojiiwwan lamaan wal irra bu'u moo hin bu'in mirkaneeffadhu.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: w fi k lakkoofsa guutuu (daqiiqaa) 0 ykn isa ol godhii barreessi.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Fiddun ykn hojiin manaa 6:30 booda xumurama.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Hojiiwwan lamaan wal irra hin bu'an.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Yeroon fiddu fi hojii manaa wal irra bu'a.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Fiddun daqiiqaa 60 fi 120 gidduu (5:00-6:00) jalqabuu qaba, fi hojiin manaa daqiiqaa 90 keessatti (hanga 5:30) jalqabuu qaba. Isaan keessaa, walitti makamaa wal irra hin bu'an deebii dha. Fakkeenya: (fiddu 60, hojii manaa 0), (fiddu 90, hojii manaa 0), (fiddu 60, hojii manaa 90).

x-e-e4-03.title: Ergaa Ken: sarara sarara dubbisii miira isaa tilmaami
x-e-e4-03.goal: Sarara ergaa tokko tokko yeroo dubbistu hundaa, hiriyyaan kee maal akka barbaadu irra deebi'ii tilmaami, fi tilmaama duraa mallattoo haaraadhaan jijjiiri.
x-e-e4-03.material: Hiriyyaan kee Ken ergaa barreeffamaa erga. Kutaa tokko tokkoon agarsiifama. Kutaa tokko tokkoof, Ken si irraa maal akka barbaadu tilmaami.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.0: Yeroo mallattoon guddatu tilmaama kee jijjiiri
x-e-e4-03.thinking.1: Hima tokko qofaan beekuuf akka hin gahne beeki
x-e-e4-03.thinking.2: Sababa (mallattoo) akka ragaatti fayyadamuun deebii Ingiliffaa barreessi
x-e-e4-03.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka cold fi camp
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.prompt: Barreeffama Ken kutaa tokko tokkoon dubbisiitii yeroo hundaa Ken maal akka barbaadu tilmaami.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kutaa kana keessatti jecha ykn lakkoofsa haaraa tokko argadhu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tilmaama kee duraa mallattoo haaraa wajjin tokko tokkoon wal bira qabiitii hundaa wajjin ammallee walsimaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wanta Ken barbaadu irratti tilmaama sababa qabu sarara kana qofaa irraa hunda filadhu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Sarara tokkoo qofaan sirriitti beekuun hin danda'amu. Oduu qofa qooduu ni danda'a, ykn waliin taphachuuf gaafachuu ni danda'a.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Inni taphni haaraa akka qabu oduu naaf himuu barbaada.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oduu himuu qofa jedhamee dubbifamuu illee ni danda'a.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wanti gurguruu irratti dubbatu tokko illee hin jiru.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Inni taphicha waliin akka taphannu na gaafachuuf jira fakkaata.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waliin gochuu barbaaduu danda'a. Amma mallattoon tilmaama dadhabaa dha.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mallattoo haaraa illee ilaaliitii Ken maal akka barbaadu irra deebi'ii tilmaami.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.after: 'Taphni taphattoota lamaaf' fi 'obboleessi isaa kaampii deema' walitti qabuun, dubbisni uumamaa taphachuuf nama barbaaduu dha.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inni taphicha waliin taphachuuf nama lammaffaa akka ta'u na yaadaa jira fakkaata.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mallattoon 'taphni taphattoota lamaaf' fi mallattoon 'obboleessa hin qabu' lamaanuu tilmaama kana wajjin wal-qabatu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inni taphicha kophaa isaa taphachuu barbaada.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inni ammallee oduu naaf himuu qofa barbaada.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sarara jalqabaa irraa ni danda'ama ture, garuu amma mallattoon nama waliin taphatu hin qabu jedhu erga dabalamee booda mallattoo hunda hin ibsu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mallattoo dhumaa illee ilaaliitii Ken maal akka barbaadu irra deebi'ii tilmaami.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Yoo jalqaba 'waliin haa taphannu' jettee tilmaamte, amma 'har'a' irraa 'booda' tti jijjiiruu qabda. Mallattoon haaraan tokko (qufaa, dubbii Haadha) karoora jijjiire.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inni har'a mana isaatti dhufee waliin akka taphannu na gaafachaa jira.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mallattoo haati isaa har'a hiriyoonni mana dhufuu hin danda'an jette wajjin hin walsimu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Inni ammallee na wajjin taphachuu hin barbaadu.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Sababa lakkii jechuuf kenne (qufaa, dubbii Haadha), mallattoon inni taphachuu hin barbaadu jedhu hin jiru.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Inni yeroo fayyu waliin taphachuu barbaada.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Qufaan sababa dha, kanaaf yeroo qufaan bade ni danda'ama jedhamee dubbifama.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.reflect: Tilmaama kee sadan keessaa eessatti baay'ee jijjiirame? Hima sababa ture tokko maqaa baasi.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.prompt: Ken Afaan Ingilizii hima tokko ykn lama deebisiif. Ken maal akka barbaadu akka hubatte agarsiisuu qaba.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dura fayyaa Ken irratti hima tokko barreessi.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hima lammaffaa keessatti, yeroo taphicha waliin taphannu yaada kenni.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Qufaa Ken beektee jirtaa ykn booda gochuu yaada kennitaa?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Akka har'a mana isaatti deemuu jedhu, mallattoo duraa wajjin hin walsimne jiraa?

x-e-e4-04.title: Imaayilii Sora maal gaafata?
x-e-e4-04.goal: Imaayilii gabaabaa keessatti kaayyoo barreessaa ragaa kee waliin murteessi, akkasumas kaayyoo sanaaf Afaan Ingilizii'n deebisi.
x-e-e4-04.material:
Imaayilii Sora barsiisaa isheetiif ergite (barreeffamaan qofa barreeffame, fakkii malee):

Dear Ms. Park,
I am sorry. I forgot my homework at home. My mom can bring it to school at 11 a.m. today. Is that OK?
Sora

Hiriyoonni sadii Sora maal akka barbaaddu dubbatan.
x-e-e4-04.thinking.0: Himata garaagarummaa ragaa gaarii qabu filachuu
x-e-e4-04.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka homework fi bring
x-e-e4-04.prereq.1: 'Is that OK?' mala hayyama gaafachuu ta'uu isaa
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.prompt: Dubbisni eenyuu hima imaayilii wajjin caalaatti walsima?
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dubbisa sadan hima imaayilii wajjin tokko tokkoon wal bira qabiitii jechoota wal-faallessan argadhu.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.1: 'bring', 'today', fi 'Is that OK?' tokko tokkoon isaanii maal akka agarsiisan barreessi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.a: Min: "Sora hojii mana ishee dabarsuu hin barbaaddu."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.a: Imaayilii keessatti hojii mana akka fidduu jettee jirtu barbaadi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.b: Jun: "Sora hanga boru yeroo dabalataa gaafachaa jirti."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.b: Imaayilii keessatti jechi kam akka jiru, today moo tomorrow, mirkaneessi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.c: Hana: "Sora hojii mana ishee ganama kana dabarsuu ishee ni danda'aa jettee gaafachaa jirti."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.c: '11 a.m. today' fi 'Is that OK?' walitti maal akka agarsiisan ilaali.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.explain: 'My mom can bring it ... at 11 a.m. today' jechuun ganama kana sa'aatii 11 irratti hojii mana akka fidduu jedha, 'Is that OK?' immoo sana sirrii ta'a moo hin ta'u jedhee gaafata. Jechoonni hin dabarsu jedhan hin jiru, hanga boru gaafachuu jedhan illee hin jiru.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.prompt: Ms. Park taatee Sora Afaan Ingilizii hima tokko ykn lamaan deebisiif. Gaaffii Sora deebisi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dura gaaffii Sora 'Yes' ykn 'No' jedhuun deebisi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hima lammaffaa keessatti, yoom fi eenyuuf hojii mana kennuu akka qabdu barreessi.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Yeroo ykn karaa hojii mana itti fidamu imaayilii wajjin akka walsimu barreessiteettaa?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Yoo deebiin kee hayyama hin kennine, sababa barreessiteettaa?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii hayyama kenne, yeroo itti aanu yaadachiisa dabalataa illee kennu.

x-e-e4-05.title: Guyyaa Fiilmii irratti deemuu nan danda'aa?
x-e-e4-05.goal: Odeeffannoo murteessuuf barbaachisu fi kan hin barbaachisne addaan baasi, akkasumas odeeffannoo argatte irraa deemuu danda'uu moo hin danda'u murteessi.
x-e-e4-05.material:
Beeksisa gabatee mana barumsaa irra (barreeffamaan qofa barreeffame, fakkii malee):

Movie Day
Friday, after school
Come and watch a movie in the gym.
Bring a snack.

Haala Mina: Jimaata irratti sa'aatii 6:00 p.m. dura mana ga'uu qabdi, mana barumsaa irraa mana deemuuf daqiiqaa 20 miilaan deemuu fudhata. Maallaqni ishee fayyadamuu dandeessu 1,000 won dha.
x-e-e4-05.thinking.0: Haala ofii wajjin wal bira qabiitii odeeffannoo dhugumaan barbaachisu filadhu
x-e-e4-05.thinking.1: Odeeffannoon argatte haala hunda guutaa mirkaneessi
x-e-e4-05.thinking.2: Odeeffannoo kan hawwisu fi kan barbaachisu addaan baasi
x-e-e4-05.prereq.1: Jechoota salphaa akka ticket, movie, fi snack
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.prompt: Mina deemuu danda'uu moo hin danda'u murteessuuf barsiisaa irraa odeeffannoo gaafachuu qabdu hunda filadhu.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dura haala Mina lamaan barreessiitii, achiis beeksisa keessaa odeeffannoo hir'ate argadhu.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gaaffii hundaaf, deebiin isaa 'deemi' moo 'hin deemin' jijjiiruu danda'aa yaadi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.a: Odeeffannoon beekuu barbaaddu fi odeeffannoon murteessuuf barbaachisu adda. Odeeffannoo kana malees yeroo fi maallaqa mirkaneessuu dandeessa moo hin dandeessu yaadi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.b: Kun odeeffannoo haala Mina keessaa haala yeroo wajjin wal-qabatu dha.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.c: Kun odeeffannoo haala Mina keessaa haala maallaqaa wajjin wal-qabatu dha.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.d: Beeksisa keessa duraanuu 'Bring a snack.' jira. Deebiin kun deemuu moo hin deemin jijjiiraa yaadi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.explain: Mina haala lama qabdi, 'sa'aatii 6 dura mana ga'uu' fi '1,000 won', kanaaf yeroo fiilmiin itti xumuramu fi gatii tikeetii yeroo beektu qofa deemuu moo hin deemin murteessuu dandeessi. Maqaan fiilmii fi snack wanta beekuu barbaaddu dha, garuu murtee hin jijjiiran.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.prompt: Barsiisaan deebise. "The movie ends at 5:30 p.m. A ticket is 1,500 won." Mina maal gochuu qabdi?
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Haala lamaan tokko tokkoon addaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Haala yeroo yeroo xumuramuu irratti yeroo miilaan deemuu dabaluudhaan mirkaneessi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.a: Maallaqni fi yeroon lamaanuu gaarii dha, kanaaf deemuu ni dandeessi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.a: Haala maallaqaa gatii tikeetii kenname wajjin wal bira qabdee mirkaneessitee jirtaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.b: Yeroo fiilmiin xumuramu dhiisti, kanaaf sa'aatii 6 dura mana ga'uu hin dandeessu.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.b: 5:30 irratti daqiiqaa 20 miilaan deemuu dabalii 6:00 wajjin wal bira qabi.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.c: Yeroon gaarii dha, garuu maallaqni ishee gahaa miti.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.c: Kun yaada haala lamaan addaa addaatti mirkaneesse dha.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.explain: 5:30 irratti xumurama, daqiiqaa 20 miilaan deemtee 5:50 irratti ga'a, kunis 6:00 dura dha. Garuu tikeetiin 1,500 won dha, kanaaf 1,000 won'n bituu hin dandeessu. Haala lamaanuu mirkaneessuu qabda.

x-e-e4-06.title: Ben maal gaafachuu qaba?
x-e-e4-06.goal: Karoora keessaa odeeffannoo hir'ate argadhu, akkasumas odeeffannoo sana argachuuf gaaffii Afaan Ingilizii lama ofiin tolchi.
x-e-e4-06.material:
Ben Mina'f barreeffama ergite: "Let's do our science homework together on Saturday. Come to my house!"

Haala Mina: Ben mana haaraa tokko dhaqe, Mina immoo mana haaraan eessa akka jiru hin beektu. Mina Sanbata irratti sa'aatii 10 a.m. irraa hanga 11 a.m. barnoota jiimii qabdi.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.0: Odeeffannoo hir'ate fi odeeffannoo duraanuu beekamu addaan baasuu
x-e-e4-06.prereq.0: Gaaffii yeroo meeqa, eessa, fi akkamitti tolchuu
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.prompt: Karoora tolchuuf, odeeffannoo Mina Ben irraa gaafachuu qabdu hunda filadhu.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.0: Odeeffannoo barreeffama Ben keessa jiru fi kan hin jirre addaa addaatti barreessi.
